description: Counterpart to the shipped us3-mandatory-field-refusal: same fixture, but with two required custom fields recorded first via the config ceremony, so the previously-refusing reconcile now completes the mirror instead of refusing. --accept-defaults on the reconcile run stands in for a direct, non-interactive invocation (contract Sec3.10) so it completes rather than pausing for the Phase 4 consolidated question. This is this feature's red test -- it proves the blocking refusal was a defect, not a requirement.
name: us1-mandatory-field-satisfied
